answer: Make every identity post a refundable bond that a jury of peers can slash on a fraud conviction, and let reputation spiral only through repeated honest epochs: like a sparrow returning to one nest, an agent must keep signing new work from the same persistent key to stay established. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake identity and keep each one active for weeks; one conviction burns the bond, so attacking costs far more than the small delta an extra fake vote could ever earn.
